Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.cosmetics

Class CosmeticTypeDefinition

java.lang.Object
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.cosmetics.CosmeticTypeDefinition
public final class CosmeticTypeDefinition extends Object
How an addon's cosmetic type shows in /cosmetics and when it triggers. Immutable; build one with builder(String) and register it with CosmeticsService.registerType(org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin, dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.cosmetics.CosmeticTypeDefinition, dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.cosmetics.CosmeticHandler). 

 CosmeticTypeDefinition hats = CosmeticTypeDefinition.builder("hats")
     .name("&eHats")
     .description(List.of("&fChoose the hat you wear", "&fin every match."))
     .icon(new ItemStack(Material.LEATHER_HELMET))
     .triggers(CosmeticMoment.GAME_START, CosmeticMoment.GAME_LEAVE)
     .build();
